newsitem.title: USA: FBI to hold briefing on Olympic bombing.
newsitem.headline: FBI to hold briefing on Olympic bombing.

text.p: The Federal Bureau of Investigation said Monday it planned to hold a news conference later in the day to discuss its investigation of the July 27 bombing in Centennial Olympic Park.

A spokeswoman said the briefing was planned for 2 p.m. EST in Atlanta. She said she could not disclose additional details but media reports said the FBI planned to offer a reward for information leading to an arrest and conviction.
The FBI has said very little about the bombing in the 4-1/2 months since the explosion, which killed two people and injured more than 100 others.

Security guard Richard Jewell, who alerted authorities to a knapsack containing the bomb, was initially identified as a suspect but was cleared on Oct. 26 when a federal prosecutor notified Jewell by letter he was no longer a target of the investigation.
